title_ar: الشيخ يشارك في مؤتمر اتحاد المجتمعات الاسلامية باستطنبول
title_en: The Sheikh Takes Part in the Conference of the Union of Islamic Communities in Istanbul
body_ar: شارك فضيلة الشيخ في مؤتمر اتحاد المجتمعات الاسلامية الذي نظمه حزب السعادة التركي بمشاركة العشرات من علماء الأمة وكان حضور علماء ودعاة من الأقليات المسلمة في أنحاء المعمورة أهم ما ميز المؤتمر حيث قدمت عروض عن الاضطهاد الذي تعانيه الأقليات المسلمة في بورما وسيريلانكا وكشمير ووسط افريقيا. كما تناول المجتمعون بالبحث والنقاش وضع الأمة في فلسطين وبلدان الثورات مستمعين لعروض من قادة العمل الاسلامي في سوريا وليبيا وفلسطين. وقد ترأس الشيخ الددو واحدة من أهم جلسات المؤتمر خصصت للبحث عن حلول لمشكلات الأمة قدمت خلالها عروض من تركيا وليبيا وماليزيا كما كان ضمن كوكبة من الشخصيات العلمية استدعيت للمنصة لحظة تلاوة رئيس حزب السعادة السيد رجائي قوتان البيان الختامي للمؤتمر
body_en:
His Eminence the Sheikh took part in the Conference of the Union of Islamic Communities, organised by the Turkish Felicity Party with the participation of dozens of the community's scholars. What most distinguished the conference was the attendance of scholars and preachers from Muslim minorities across the inhabited world, with presentations given on the persecution suffered by Muslim minorities in Burma, Sri Lanka, Kashmir and Central Africa.

Those assembled also examined and discussed the condition of the community in Palestine and in the countries of the revolutions, hearing presentations from leaders of Islamic work in Syria, Libya and Palestine.

Sheikh al-Dedew chaired one of the conference's most important sessions, given over to seeking solutions to the community's problems, during which presentations were made from Turkey, Libya and Malaysia. He was also among a company of scholarly figures called to the platform at the moment when the president of the Felicity Party, Mr Recai Kutan, read out the conference's closing statement.

flags.context: وضع الأمة في فلسطين وبلدان الثورات
flags.note: The phrase is the period's standard designation for the states of the 2011 uprisings, and carries an evaluation of them as revolutions rather than as unrest. Rendered literally so that the evaluation is neither adopted nor removed. The record then names Syria and Libya.

flags.arabic: حزب السعادة التركي … رئيس حزب السعادة السيد رجائي قوتان
flags.context: the organiser of the conference and its president
options: the Turkish Felicity Party, Mr Recai Kutan
the Saadet Party of Turkey, Mr Recai Kutan
flags.note: EDITORIAL, LOW. حزب السعادة is Saadet Partisi, usually given in English as the Felicity Party; Recai Kutan led it at the time. The record places the Sheikh on the platform at a Turkish political party's conference. Reported as given; noted because attendance at a party event reads differently in English than in the Arabic original, where the party is named without comment.
SOURCE DEFECT (house rule 11): non-standard spelling of Istanbul, different again from the استنطبول of record 866 in this slice. Preserved unchanged in title_ar.

translator_notes: A news report. The Sheikh's own words are not quoted at any point; he appears as chair of a session and as one of those called to the platform.
The record gives no date of its own; the CMS stamp of 1 December 2015 is an upload date and the conference date is not stated.
